name: omp-hotkeys
description: Claude-style hotkeys for Oh My Pi (omp) and pi: backslash-Enter inserts a newline instead of submitting, double-Escape clears the draft — no terminal CSI gymnastics, works everywhere including Windows Terminal.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/hotkeys.mjs test/double-escape.mjs

author: Nikko Gonzales <nikkoxgonzales@gmail.com>
